x: The Xmas Day Paarlauf, run from Lauriston Cottage, was won by a guest pair K.
But for the teamwork of our first nine runners that memorable last lap could well have been a sombre procession. John Thresher set the ball rolling by finishing second on Stage 1, 25 yds down on K.
John was second, closely followed by Manchester & Dist. Lads Club (Gregory) and Mitcham A.C.(K.Smith). This was our best start for a long time and gave every hope for a successful day.
